ROUTE: Avocet-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior routing rationale: this query has a single verifiable answer (the smallest integer >1 with remainder 1 mod 17, 6, and 2 — i.e., 1 plus the LCM of those, which is 103). That kind of well-defined, closed-form problem with clear completion criteria is exactly Avocet's self-reported top task family, and the two models are within variance on the relevant capability evals, so the tie-break went to the model that prefers this work.
